backend/main.mo: Defines data types and authorization‑gated CRUD logic for user profiles, food preservation tips, and science explanations using state maps.
feature_evidence.json: Provides feature-to-file mapping and metadata summarizing implemented frontend features with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of each frontend component, hook, and stylesheet.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and OKLCH-based warm color theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx and mounts it to the root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component managing authentication, profile loading, view switching, and initial landing screen.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity auth flow and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting new users to enter their name and saving the profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/common/EmptyStat: Reusable component displaying an empty-state message with optional illustration and action.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Reusable error display component with optional retry action and destructive alert styling.
Defines the main app layout with header, navigation tabs, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useMyTips.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch a user's tips or a single tip using the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useScienceLib: Implements hooks to fetch all science explanations, a specific explanation, or explanations by category.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useTipMutatio: Contains mutations to create, update, and delete tips while invalidating relevant queries.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useUserProfil: Adds hooks to load and save the caller's user profile via the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading, login, logout, and identity persistence logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup with custom warm-themed color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/screens/MyTips/MyTipsScreen: Renders the user's tips list with states for loading, errors, creating, viewing, and editing tips.
frontend/src/screens/MyTips/TipDetailPan: Displays a detailed view of a user tip with edit and delete actions, tags, and timestamps.
frontend/src/screens/MyTips/TipEditor.ts: Provides a form to create or edit a tip with validation, tag management, and submit handling.
frontend/src/screens/ScienceLibrary/Scie: Lists science explanations grouped by category with loading, error, and selection handling.
Shows detailed information for a selected science explanation including summary, steps, and safety notes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration customizing colors, layout, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Stores overall app state, features, and image requirements for a food preservation tips app, including existing features and pending feature requests.
